legacy_ports.name: fitted
legacy_ports.constraints: Unmodified Fitted state and revalidated source configuration. Predict mean window probabilities for calibration recordings without fitting model/scaling. Call the existing generic float64 empirical-F1 provider on one score column and int64 binary labels. Inclusive comparison and highest observed threshold among equal F1 values. Return threshold and calibration count while retaining fitted state. This selects a decision threshold, not calibrated probabilities or unbiased accuracy. Caller owns meaningful subject identities; calibration labels must not be used to train the model.

legacy_ports.name: prepared
legacy_ports.constraints: Revalidated immutable Prepared configuration. Fixed windows stay within recordings; trailing incomplete samples omitted. Periodic Hann segment-mean-detrended one-sided density PSD with log1p. Recording-balanced training-only channel scaling, constant scales replaced by one. CPU float64 dual 1D waveform/2D spectrogram CNN with frequency-preserving pooling. Seeded time/frequency masks on normalized spectra; class/recording-balanced BCE, Adam and one accumulated update per epoch. All features are materialized in memory; batch size bounds neural forward allocation only. No early stopping, pretrained model, subject-equal weighting or empirical accuracy claim. Trusted model/scaling objects, no portable persistence.

legacy_ports.name: calibrated
legacy_ports.constraints: Unmodified Calibrated state. Revalidate configuration, predict ordered mean window query scores and apply the existing inclusive column-threshold provider. Return finite JSON scores/classes/threshold, population and window counts, omitted query samples, epochs and initial/final training loss. Query labels are prohibited. No refit; trusted in-process model state. Predictions are generic binary recording results, not a clinical interpretation, named submission format or independent accuracy claim.

legacy_ports.name: payload
legacy_ports.constraints: Exact finite version-1 JSON with training, calibration, unlabeled query and explicit controls. Nonempty rectangular channel/time signals with a common channel count; caller guarantees consistent channel meaning, units and sample rate. Each labeled population has both binary classes. Nonempty subject keys must be disjoint across populations. Validated window/stride/FFT/hop, seed, width, epochs, batch size, learning rate and mask limits. Return detached immutable JSON configuration; no automatic montage or identity discovery.

legacy_ports.name: scores
legacy_ports.constraints:
input scores. Apply inclusive per-column thresholds to finite float64 scores (N,L).

Scores must be nonempty and in [0,1]. Thresholds are a finite float64 vector
(L,), allowed outside [0,1] to express all/none decisions. Returns a new
int64 binary matrix of identical shape. No fitting, clipping or mutation.

legacy_ports.name: scores
legacy_ports.constraints:
input scores. Maximize held-out empirical F1 independently for each score column.

Nonempty finite float64 scores (N,L) in [0,1] and aligned int64 binary
labels are required; every column must contain both classes. Predictions
use score >= threshold. Among equal computed float64 F1 values, choose
the highest observed-score threshold. Tied scores are processed together.
Returns a new float64 vector (L,); inputs are unchanged. Sorting takes
O(L*N*log(N)) time and O(N) temporary memory per column.

Caller must enforce training/calibration/query separation. This fits a
decision threshold, not calibrated probabilities or unbiased accuracy.
No expected-F1 approximation, class weighting or domain policy is used.
